description: Social layer + deploy readiness: per-day/per-place photo gallery with client-side image compression before Supabase Storage upload; the public Instagram-grade 'Moments' recap page with Open Graph sharing meta; SETUP.md with exact Supabase/Maps/env/Vercel steps; README; final full-project verification. Depends on FEAT-002 (storage) and FEAT-003 (shell). Last feature.
steps: Gallery: src/lib/images/compress.ts (resize/compress via browser-image-compression before upload to protect free tier), src/app/(app)/gallery/page.tsx + src/components/gallery/* — per-day/per-place grid + lightbox; upload to Supabase Storage 'photos' bucket when available, else seeded sample state with a disabled uploader.

Moments: src/app/moments/page.tsx + src/components/moments/* — a public (NOT editor-gated) warm, beautiful recap stitching hero, route, day highlights and photo highlights; add Open Graph + Twitter card metadata so the shared link previews well. Accessible and fast; renders fully in mock mode from seed.

Write SETUP.md with exact steps: (1) create a Supabase project, run supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql then supabase/seed.sql in the SQL editor, create 'photos' and 'documents' Storage buckets with the stated access policy; (2) create a Google Maps API key, RESTRICT it with an HTTP-referrer restriction AND a HARD quota cap so it can never incur charges; (3) copy .env.local.example to .env.local and fill every variable; (4) deploy to Vercel (import repo, set the same env vars in project settings, deploy). Write/complete README.md describing the app and the mock mode.
Final verification pass: ensure no secrets are hardcoded anywhere (grep for obvious key patterns), .env.local is gitignored, .env.local.example lists every variable.
Commit locally: `git add -A && git commit -m "feat: photo gallery, moments recap page, SETUP docs, deploy prep"`.
acceptance_criteria: `/moments` renders fully in mock mode from seed with Open Graph meta present; no editor gate.
Gallery grid + lightbox render in mock mode; compress.ts typechecks and is called before any upload.
SETUP.md contains all four numbered sections including the Maps key referrer-restriction AND hard quota cap, and the exact migration/seed filenames.

`.env.local` is gitignored; `.env.local.example` lists GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY (and NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY if used), NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, EDITOR_PASSWORD.
Full gate passes: `npm run lint` && `npx tsc --noEmit` && `npm run build`, and `npm run dev` loads every section navigable with no .env.local.
verification: cd d:\Personal-Projects\trip-site; npm run lint; npx tsc --noEmit; npm run build  (no .env.local)
npm run dev; load /moments and /gallery in mock mode; verify every segment is reachable
findings:
Implemented the social layer + deploy docs (final feature). Key decisions and paths for future reference:

ROUTE DECISION: The old in-shell placeholder src/app/(app)/moments/page.tsx was DELETED. The public recap now lives at src/app/moments/page.tsx, OUTSIDE the (app) route group, so it renders full-bleed with no shell and is NOT editor-gated. (Both files would have resolved to /moments and collided.) Nav (src/components/nav/segments.ts) now has TWO tabs: 'Gallery' -> /gallery (in-shell) and 'Moments' -> /moments (public page). Both are reachable from sidebar + bottom tabs.

GALLERY (in (app) shell): src/app/(app)/gallery/page.tsx renders <Gallery days seed> (client). Components in src/components/gallery/: Gallery.tsx (groups photos by day via trip.days order, lightbox state), PhotoTile.tsx (square tile; renders Image when a url resolves, else warm gradient placeholder with caption), PhotoLightbox.tsx (fixed overlay, Esc/arrow-key nav), PhotoUploader.tsx (editor-gated; calls compressImage BEFORE storage.upload; disabled in mock mode). Uses useEntityList('photos', seed) + repository upsert.

IMAGES: src/lib/images/compress.ts exports compressImage(file, options?) -> { file, originalBytes, compressedBytes }; wraps browser-image-compression (added to package.json, ^2.0.2); DEFAULT_OPTIONS maxSizeMB 0.8, maxWidthOrHeight 1920, useWebWorker, fileType image/webp; never throws (falls back to original). src/lib/images/storage.ts exports PHOTOS_BUCKET='photos' and resolvePhotoUrl(path) -> public URL via client.storage.getPublicUrl, null in mock mode.

MOMENTS (public): src/app/moments/page.tsx exports Next `metadata` with openGraph + twitter (summary_large_image) card. Server component, renders fully from seed in mock mode. Sections in src/components/moments/: MomentsHero, MomentsRoute (uses ROUTE_POINTS from src/lib/maps/route.ts + trip totals), MomentsDays (seed days, skips checkout day where overnight===null), MomentsGallery (server-rendered placeholder tiles from seed photos, no client JS).

SEED: Added `photos: Photo[]` export to src/lib/seed/trip-seed.ts (6 placeholder photos, url:null, each with caption + dayId + placeId mapping to itinerary anchor stops). Wired into src/lib/data/mock-store.ts (seedPhotos now hydrate store.photos; previously photos started empty). Photo type already existed in types.ts; photos table + 'photos'/'documents' bucket docs already in supabase/migrations/0001_init.sql (photos bucket = public read, documents = private/signed URLs).

DOCS: SETUP.md (4 numbered sections: Supabase project + run 0001_init.sql then seed.sql + create photos[public]/documents[private] buckets; Google Maps key with HTTP-referrer restriction AND hard quota cap; copy .env.local.example -> .env.local fill all 6 vars; Vercel import + env + deploy). README.md rewritten (segments list, mock mode, editor mode, free-tier guardrails).

SECURITY: No hardcoded secrets (grep clean). .env.local confirmed gitignored (git status --ignored shows '!! .env.local'). .env.local.example unchanged, already lists all 5 required vars. Added dev.log/dev.out.log/dev.err.log to .gitignore (throwaway dev-server logs).

VERIFICATION (no .env.local): npm run lint PASS; npm run build PASS (all 23 routes incl /gallery and /moments prerendered '○ Static'); npx tsc --noEmit PASS=exit 0 but ONLY after a build has generated .next/types (Next 16 relies on generated global types like LayoutProps and per-route validators). Correct gate order on a clean tree is build THEN tsc; running tsc against a stale/absent .next yields false errors. The in-shell /itinerary/[day] uses PPR (◐).
